How to interpret the curves

Black dashed: reference; gray: before adaptation; orange: No CL; blue, green and purple: CL beta 1, 4 and 16. A trace that ends early is a failed simulation, not successful tracking. All methods use matching reference IDs. Showing a candidate is separate from selecting it as scientifically acceptable.

HTML is self-contained. PDF and PNG figures are also saved separately in figures/. CSV files contain all metrics. No weights, data splits, selection limits or old measurements were changed to produce this comparison.
